messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock launch gates for the inference routing feature. Customers are asking for clear SLOs + a fallback plan if tail latency spikes. Who owns the acceptance criteria?
raj (SRE): I can own infra SLOs. Need clear latency percentiles, error budget burn policy, and fallback triggers.
lina (Eng): For runtime: fallback means redirect to smaller model variant + KV-prefetch disabled. That reduces QPS cost but increases hallucination risk. Need acceptance criteria. :thinking:
tom (Product Director): Priority: make GA safe for mid-market customers on Dedicated. Minimal acceptable: p95 <= 220ms, p99 <= 600ms, error rate < 0.5% over 24h. If that fails, auto-failover to variant-beta.
eva (QA): We should codify edge cases: cold-starts, long-context prompts, batching shifts. Test matrices + synthetic traffic for each.
raj (SRE): Also propose an explicit error budget policy: if 15m burn rate > 3x baseline, trigger canary rollback and route 30% traffic to fallback region for 10m.
lina (Eng): Implementation note: we can expose two flags per route: `preferred_model` and `fallback_model` and `latency_guard_ms`. Example:```json
{"preferred_model":"redwood-13b-opt","fallback_model":"redwood-6b-quant","latency_guard_ms":600}```
maya (PM): Nice. Can we agree on acceptance criteria for PRD? I'd propose: 1) p95/p99 targets met in 90% of production windows; 2) automated fallback triggers exercised in canary; 3) no more than 1 customer-facing incident caused by model routing in first 30d.
tom (Product Director): Agree with Maya but tweak p99: must be <= 700ms for specific long-context customers (we'll list ~3 early adopters).
eva (QA): I'll add test cases for request sequences that cause KV eviction and for multi-tenant cache collisions. Also load tests with synthetic tail latency spikes.
raj (SRE): One more: instrument `slo_error_budget` metric and add a dashboard. Alerting: Sev1 when error budget consumption > 50% in 1h with rising slope.
lina (Eng): Edge case: what if fallback model differs semantically—clients using structured outputs may break. Need contract tests for function-calling and schema validation before failover.
maya (PM): Good call. Add contract tests as gating checks in canary pipeline. We should also document a manual rollback runbook for customer support. I'll add to PRD. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for routing-feature-v3 -> canary-10%
tom (Product Director): Plan for rollout: canary (10% 24h) -> canary (30% 48h) -> gradual (60% 72h) -> GA. Each step requires SLOs + no critical regressions.
maya (PM): Action items: @raj create dashboard + alerts, @lina add fallback flags + contract tests, @eva add QA matrix and synthetic tests, I'll update PRD with acceptance criteria and runbook. Anyone opposed?
raj (SRE): 👍
lina (Eng): 👍 will send PR with schema by EOD.
eva (QA): 👍 will schedule tests for canary window.
tom (Product Director): ok, locking this approach. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
